issue.title: 53 stale publication-protection blocks on already-acknowledged hoods are never revisited, so doctor WARNs forever
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1r8.6 (note #4, epic sase-1r8, "Stop agent publication false blocks, parked-row floods, and drain starvation"); triaged and re-verified by the sase-1r8 land agent on 2026-11-04.

Epic sase-1r8 made scanner-hit publication-protection blocks rules-versioned (sase-core 542448a0, sase cdfbb82d2b). The reviewer chose `revalidation = automatic`: a block recorded under older scanner rules stops being enforced, and the next publish attempt for the same (repository, path, sha256) rescans it. A clean rescan moves the block to `superseded` with provenance. The reviewer rejected a separate revalidate command.

On athena after the reinstall (rules v2, outbox schema 8), 15 blocks were superseded this way. 53 records remain stale and nothing will ever revisit them:

- bob-cli: 43 `openai-key`
- sase: 4 `openai-key`, 4 `high-entropy-assignment`, 1 `stripe-key`
- tailnet: 1 `openai-key`

Every record sits on an `agents/<agent>/chat.md` path of an older hood, for example `--mon` agents. The `affected_requests` (`run-…` ids) match no outbox row. Their requests were acknowledged long ago with the content withheld, so no drain, retry, or `--retry-quarantined` path reaches them. Two consequences:

1. `sase doctor -C state.agent_publication_protection` stays WARN permanently ("0 enforced blocked, 53 stale awaiting revalidation"). Its next step, "Retry publication to rescan stale scanner-hit blocks under the current rules", has no command that can act on it.
2. The withheld `chat.md` bytes of those hoods are likely still missing from the published sase--agents sidecar, even where v2 rescans them clean. The 15 superseded ones were mostly v1 false positives inside hyphenated `task-…` names.

Decide and implement one remedy within the `revalidation = automatic` decision. Options:

- (a) Have doctor report stale-only state as non-WARN, since stale blocks no longer withhold anything.
- (b) Republish the affected hoods once, bounded, through an existing reconcile path (for example a targeted full-sync of those agents), so the normal rescan supersedes them.
- (c) Both.

Do not print any content. Building a new report-first revalidate command reopens the rejected `revalidation = command` branch, so propose it only through `/sase_gate` with that context.

task_type_fields.impact: Permanent doctor WARN with an unactionable next step; previously false-blocked transcript files on those hoods stay missing from the published sase--agents sidecar.
task_type_fields.repro: Run sase doctor -C state.agent_publication_protection -j on athena: status WARN, stale_count 53, superseded_count 15, blocked_count 0. Map each record's affected_requests (run-… ids) against the project's agents-publication-outbox.json items: none match, so no drain or retry path will republish them.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1r8 verify phase left 53 stale scanner-hit blocks whose requests no longer exist; automatic revalidation only fires on a publish attempt that will never come, so the doctor WARN cannot clear and the withheld bytes stay unpublished.
